resource-hero.looks: The resource page opening: breadcrumb, title, intro, body text, 'Watch Video' and 'Download Resource' buttons, and a hero image.
resource-hero.use: Only on resource pages, which the backend generates.

fields.resourceBody: The resource description: a paragraph or two, lists allowed.
fields.content_breadcrumbs: e.g. 'Resources > NetSmartz'; Label::/path makes a crumb a link.
fields.watchLabel: The video button's words; the button shows only when a video is set.
fields.downloadLabel: The download button's words; the button shows only when a file or URL is set.
